instruction: Please implement a website for visualizing the data analysis of Messi and Ronaldo's performance in the Champions League, to compare their goal-scoring abilities. The website should have various visualization charts, including bar charts, rose charts, creative scatter plots, and radar charts. Users should be able to browse different charts and perform interactive data analysis, including pop-up prompts, page resets, and dynamic highlighting of chart data. The website should also include overall page design, chart drawing, and implementation of interactive data analysis functions. Assign light sea green to the background and dark slate gray to the UI elements.

Please implement a WeChat mini-program for a yearly meeting lottery that randomly selects prizes. Users should be able to scan a code to enter the mini-program, browse the prize list, participate in the lottery, and view the winning results. The mini-program should have functionalities for displaying prizes, conducting the lottery, and announcing winners. Users should be able to view their own winning records and share winning information on social media. Choose white smoke for global background and rosy brown for all components.

Please implement a comprehensive service platform settlement system for company and merchant settlement management. The system should have a management end and a merchant end. The management end can manage settlement information, view settlement records, and perform settlement operations. The merchant end can view settlement information, perform settlement operations, and view settlement records. The system should also have performance detection, error reporting, and high security features. Use pearl for the background and charcoal for components.

Please implement a school website that displays school information and message functionality. The website should include four pages: my school, learn more, campus scenery, and leave a message for me. Users should be able to browse school introductions, campus scenery, and other information, and leave messages for the school. The website should have navigation functionality to facilitate user switching between different pages. Set overall background to champagne, then style components with firebrick.

Please implement a community website to showcase and manage the physical and virtual parts of the Lei Feng Wisdom Community. The website should have functionalities for displaying community introductions, news, events, member management, and point rewards. Users should be able to register as community members, browse community dynamics, participate in events, receive point rewards, and view their personal point records. Use a light sky blue background and apply deepskyblue to the UI components.

Please implement a live form validation feature on the website that checks user input in real-time, prompting users for incorrect or incomplete information. The form should have multiple fields such as name, email, phone number, etc. After the user inputs information, the system should validate this information in real-time to ensure it meets the requirements, such as whether the email format is correct or the phone number is valid. Choose dust white for the background; set all component colors to forest green.

Please implement a financial sharing center website for Shandong Power Grid, used for financial management. The website should have functionalities for financial and tax management, invoice management, visa management, data screen display, certificate management, personnel management, and seal management. Users should be able to log in, browse financial information, manage invoices, visas, data screens, and certificates, and perform personnel and seal management. Configure your theme with eggshell as background and dark slate gray as component color.

Please implement a mobile web email proxy website for browsing and managing emails. The website should have functionalities for browsing emails, sending emails, deleting emails, and searching emails. Users should be able to log in, browse email directories such as inbox, sent box, and spam, read and reply to emails, and manage their email accounts. Set the background color to pale ash and the component color to slate gray.

Please implement a logistics management website for managing cargo sources, scheduling, vehicle services, and more. The website should have cargo source management functions, including cargo entry, tracking queries, and status operations. Scheduling management functions, including scheduling vehicles, drivers, and time for unsent cargo, generating transportation tracks, and operation records. Vehicle service functions, including managing drivers, vehicle maintenance, and vehicle insurance. Quotation management functions, including maintaining freight and insurance prices for cargo. Supplier management functions, including providing supplier accounting and settlement. User organization functions, including department management, employee management, and permission management. Apply magenta for layout; use dark violet for buttons and cards.

Please implement a helper network website for posting tasks and picking up orders. Users can register as either task publishers or helpers. Task publishers can post tasks, and helpers can browse tasks and pick up orders. The system should calculate the distance between the task publisher and the helper and generate the corresponding transportation fee. Task publishers can choose to escrow the service fee online or pay offline, and helpers can agree to or decline offline payment. After completing the task, both parties can evaluate each other. Assign sunlight to body backgrounds and gold to main components.

Please implement a management backend for an English reading platform to manage English reading resources and users. The management backend should have functionalities for managing book resources, book lists, course content, activity operations, pre-test evaluation, banner management, user management, transaction record queries, message push management, integral mall product management, and platform permission management. Administrators can log in to the backend, manage book resources, book lists, course content, activity operations, and manage users, view transaction records, send messages, manage integral mall products, and platform permissions. Select violet for layout background and indigo for component details.

Please implement an RSS subscription website for users to subscribe to and read articles. The website should have functionalities for importing and exporting OPML files, filtering, tagging, and searching. Users should be able to log in, subscribe to RSS sources of interest, read articles, and tag and search articles. The website should also support multiple users, with each user able to manage their own subscription sources and reading records. Configure your theme with light steel blue as background and dark slate gray as component color.

Please implement a fake news detection website to analyze news articles. The website should have functionalities for uploading news articles, detecting the authenticity of news, and displaying detection results. Users should be able to upload news articles, and the system will analyze the content and provide detection results, including whether the news is fake or not, and the confidence level of the detection. Define background as caramel; define components with saddle brown.

Please implement a web application based on Wicket that has user login, registration, browsing, and management functions. Users should be able to log in, browse different types of content, register new users, and manage personal information. The website should have a clear navigation menu and search function to help users quickly find the information they need. Set page background to medium spring green; color all components with green.

Please implement an image enlargement function that allows users to click on a thumbnail to view a larger image. Users should be able to mouse over the thumbnail, click the enlarge button, and view the larger image. The system should be able to display the corresponding image based on the user's actions and be able to shrink back to the thumbnail. Use cornsilk for container backgrounds and rosy brown for component visuals.

Please implement a web-based zip file management tool for reading, writing, and managing compressed files. The tool should have functionalities for browsing compressed files, adding files to the zip archive, deleting files from the zip archive, modifying files in the zip archive, and unzipping files. Users should be able to upload zip files, browse the contents of the zip file, add new files to the zip archive, delete unnecessary files, and download the unzipped files. Set page background to pale goldenrod; color all components with dark olive green.

Please implement a concurrent login system to simulate multiple user logins. The system should have the functionality to simulate multiple users logging in at the same time, set different user login information, record login results, and perform concurrent login testing based on set parameters. Users should be able to set login parameters, including username, password, etc., and the system will simulate the login process based on these parameters and record the login results. Assign pearl to body backgrounds and charcoal to main components.

Please implement a website content management system for managing and publishing website content. The system should have functionalities for adding, editing, and deleting articles. Users should be able to log in, manage articles, images, videos, and other content, publish new content, edit existing content, and delete unnecessary content. The system should also have user management and permission control functions. Style all pages with a moccasin background and burlywood components.

Please create an attractive TikTok page to attract people interested in founding a brand or startup. The page should have the functionality to display content related to entrepreneurship, including posting videos, images, and text posts. Users should be able to browse the page, follow the account, and interact with the content. The page should have a clear navigation menu, including features such as home, videos, images, and about us. Use seashell for the background and indian red for components.

Please implement a Fairy Tale website that provides video watching functionality, allowing users to log in and pay to watch videos. The website should have functionalities for video playback, paid purchases, user login, and registration. Users should be able to browse the video list, select videos of interest for paid purchase, and watch the videos after purchase. The website should also have a user center where users can view their purchase records and viewing history. Use lemon chiffon in the background layer and olive for the component layer.

Please implement a mini-program for tourism booking and merchandise purchase. The mini-program should have functionalities for managing tourist attractions, making reservations, and purchasing merchandise. Users should be able to browse attraction information, make reservations, purchase related products, and view order information. The mini-program should also have user login and registration functions, allowing users to view their order history and personal information. Apply floral white as the background; style all components with dark red.
